mechanism_claims.claim_text: AfusinC is curated as a CSalpha-beta fungal defensin with source-supported structural-class evidence, not as a mechanistically proven lipid-II binder.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural class and purified peptide evidence do not establish a direct antimicrobial mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AfusinC has source-supported bactericidal activity against Micrococcus luteus under time-kill assay conditions.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Time-kill behavior supports bactericidal phenotype but not a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper frames lipid-II targeting only as a hypothesis by analogy to other CSalpha-beta defensins; no direct AfusinC target-binding assay is reported.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote lipid-II binding or membrane disruption to direct_mechanism for this paper.
